limitations: The RDF graph alone does not preserve author/link order, nameType, nested source structures or all domain values; retain source.json and context.json.
The graph does not create a resource version relationship from a literal version.
Rights text remains a RightsStatement label, not a standardized license assertion.
No schema validation of a DOI-agency deposit or actual identifier registration was performed.
The source checksum is a placeholder copied from the existing synthetic example; no sequence bytes are provided or verified.
